description: Saves a new model to the user's account so they can open it in the browser builder and keep working on it. A fund starts from Hemrock's defaults with your inputs merged on; a cap table needs events; a waterfall needs a model and options.exitValuation. Use it when the user wants to keep a model you built in chat, and give them the url. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

cashFlows.description: Fund only: show the Forecast and Statements tabs in the builder.

events.description: Cap table only: the full list of financing events, in order, the same shape cap_table_compute takes. Replaces the saved list, so read the model first and send back the whole list with your change.

features.description: Fund only: features to switch on or off, keyed capTable, fees, waterfall, recycling, lpClasses, mgmtCo or followOn, with the same shapes as fund_economics_compute features. An object switches the feature on with that config; false switches it off and keeps its config. The user switches these on deliberately, so only change one they asked about.

fundName.description: Fund only: the fund name used in the model and its workbook.

inputs.description: Fund only: fund inputs to change, the same fields as fund_economics_compute inputs. Merged onto the saved inputs, so send only what changes.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder) or "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model).

model.description: Waterfall only: the cap stack, the same shape as exit_waterfall_compute's model. Replaces the saved one.

name.description: The model name shown in the builder. Owner only.

options.description: Cap table: { wholeShares, pricePrecision }. Waterfall: { exitValuation, exitDate, wholeShares, pricePrecision }. Merged onto the saved options.

name: create_saved_model
title: Save a new model
